description.zh: 核战争后 LinYi 号避难所的自治沙盘：居民在资源与生存压力下自行发展，拥有背包与制作能力，智能体决策受心理状态影响，社会涌现治理与文化，文明通过技术与遗物积累知识，观察者记录并可实验回放。
description.en: Autonomous sandbox of the LinYi Shelter after nuclear war: residents develop under resource and survival pressure, carry backpacks and craft; agent decisions are shaped by psyche; society evolves governance and culture; civilizations accumulate knowledge through tech and relics; the observer records and experiments.

description.zh: 智能体的完整心智与行为模型：人设、50 标签特质、心理、日程、行动预想池、背包与制作、决策、记忆、生命周期与社会角色。
description.en: Full agent model: persona, 50-tag traits, psyche, schedule, anticipation pool, backpack and crafting, decision, memory, lifecycle and social roles.

description.zh: 为智能体维护候选行动集合，并通过模拟评分选择下一步。
description.en: Maintains candidate actions and selects next steps via simulated scoring.

description.zh: 增删与修剪候选行动，保持预想池新鲜且可执行。
description.en: Adds, prunes and refreshes candidate actions in the pool.

description.zh: 按动机与性格对候选行动池打分并裁剪（保留前 K）。
description.en: Scores and prunes the candidate action pool by motivation and personality (keep top-K).

description.zh: 对单个候选打分（基础分+动机+性格）。
description.en: Scores one candidate (base + motivation + personality).

description.zh: 裁剪候选池，保留前 K 个。
description.en: Prunes candidate pool, keeps top-K.

description.zh: 按模拟评分从预想池选择候选行动并生成短名单。
description.en: Selects and shortlists pool candidates by simulated scores.

description.zh: 选择评分最高的单个候选；池为空返回 null。
description.en: Selects the top-scored candidate; null when empty.

description.zh: 生成按评分降序的前 limit 个候选。
description.en: Returns the top `limit` candidates by score desc.

description.zh: 存储与列出智能体预想池候选行动，按候选 id 幂等 upsert。
description.en: Stores and lists an agent candidate actions with id-empotent upsert.

description.zh: 向预想池写入一个候选（按 id upsert）并返回快照。
description.en: Adds/upserts a candidate and returns its snapshot.

description.zh: 列出某智能体预想池的全部候选。
description.en: Lists all candidates in an agent pool.

description.zh: 对候选行动做结果模拟与效用评分。
description.en: Simulates candidate action outcomes and scores their utility.

description.zh: 推演单个候选行动，输出期望效用与风险。
description.en: Simulates one candidate action, outputs expected utility and risk.

description.zh: 推演全部候选并按期望效用降序预测。
description.en: Simulates all candidates and predicts by expected utility desc.

description.zh: 消耗 tick 与材料制作物品、建造建筑、撰写书籍。
description.en: Consumes ticks and materials to craft items, build structures and write books.

description.zh: 消耗 tick 与材料建造或加固避难所建筑。
description.en: Consumes ticks and materials to build or reinforce shelter structures.

description.zh: 发起建筑建造：校验 + 扣材料 + 登记耗时任务。
description.en: Starts a build: validates, deducts materials and enqueues a timed job.

description.zh: 推进建造任务，归零后写入建筑结构并记录观察日志。
description.en: Advances build jobs; on completion, writes the structure and observer log.

description.zh: 定义与学习物品、建筑、书籍的制作配方。
description.en: Defines and learns recipes for items, buildings and books.

description.zh: 定义制作配方（材料、耗时 tick、能耗、产出）。
description.en: Defines a crafting recipe (materials, ticks, energy, output).

description.zh: 查询配方：全部 / 按 id / 按 kind。
description.en: Queries recipes: all, by id, or by kind.

description.zh: 记录某居民学会某配方。
description.en: Records that a resident has learned a recipe.

description.zh: 消耗 tick 与背包材料，产出物品并放入背包。
description.en: Consumes ticks and backpack materials to produce items into the backpack.

description.zh: 消耗 tick、材料与能源执行制作。
description.en: Consumes ticks, materials and energy to execute crafting.

description.zh: 发起物品制作：校验 + 扣材料 + 登记耗时任务。
description.en: Starts a craft: validates, deducts materials and enqueues a timed job.

description.zh: 推进制作任务，归零后产物入背包并写观察日志。
description.en: Advances craft jobs; on completion, stores output and writes the observer log.

description.zh: 把制作产物写入背包并记录观察日志。
description.en: Writes crafted outputs into the backpack and observer log.

description.zh: 把制作产物写入背包。
description.en: Stores the crafted output into the backpack.

description.zh: 记录一条制作观察日志（action-log）。
description.en: Records a crafting action-log entry.

description.zh: 校验配方、材料与背包库存。
description.en: Validates recipe, materials and backpack inventory.

description.zh: 校验配方、背包材料与容量，返回缺料清单。
description.en: Validates recipe, backpack materials and capacity, returning missing items.

description.zh: 返回配方所需材料与耗时。
description.en: Returns the recipe's required materials and duration.

description.zh: 消耗 tick，把记忆、知识与文化写进书籍并放入背包或图书馆。
description.en: Consumes ticks to write memory, knowledge and culture into books for the backpack or library.

description.zh: 发起著书：校验 + 扣材料 + 登记耗时任务。
description.en: Starts writing a book: validates, deducts materials and enqueues a timed job.

description.zh: 推进著书任务，归零后书籍入背包并记录观察日志。
description.en: Advances writing jobs; on completion, stores the book and observer log.

description.zh: 综合动机、预想池评分与记忆，选择最终行动并给出解释。
description.en: Chooses final actions from motivations, anticipation scores and memory, with explanations.

description.zh: 按居民当前状态（背包材料、就业、识字、同伴）生成可达行动候选，恒定包含生存骨架（eat/drink/rest/forage），再追加规则准入的动态行动（craft/build/write/work/trade/socialize/court）；不可行时给出拒绝理由。
description.en: Generates reachable action candidates from current agent state (materials, employment, literacy, peers). Always includes the survival skeleton, then appends rule-admitted dynamic actions, with a rejection reason when infeasible.

description.zh: 生成候选行动列表（生存骨架 + 规则准入的动态行动）。
description.en: Builds the candidate action list.

description.zh: 返回全部可规划行动键。
description.en: Returns all plannable action keys.

description.zh: 返回规则表（各行动的前置条件）。
description.en: Returns the rule table.

description.zh: 返回各行动的基础分。
description.en: Returns base scores.

description.zh: 把动机、预想评分、记忆与生存压力归一化为统一决策输入并排序。
description.en: Normalizes motivations, anticipation scores, memory and pressure into ranked decision inputs.

description.zh: 组装决策上下文，将四类输入归一化为 items 列表。
description.en: Assembles the context, normalizing four input kinds into items.

description.zh: 按来源权重 × 单项分数对 items 排序。
description.en: Ranks items by source weight × item score.

description.zh: 解释决策依据并生成可被观察者审计的决策轨迹。
description.en: Explains decisions and produces auditable decision traces.

description.zh: 生成人类可读决策解释（为何选 A 不选 B）。
description.en: Generates human-readable decision explanation (why A over B).

description.zh: 生成可审计的结构化决策轨迹。
description.en: Produces an auditable structured decision trace.

description.zh: 从候选行动中选择最终行动并给出 softmax 置信度。
description.en: Chooses the final action from candidates with a softmax confidence.

description.zh: 选择评分最高的候选并返回 {id, action, score, confidence, reason}。
description.en: Chooses the best candidate returning {id, action, score, confidence, reason}.

description.zh: 计算指定候选相对候选集的 softmax 置信度。
description.en: Computes softmax confidence of a candidate vs the set.

description.zh: 智能体拥有背包，携带、交换与使用物品。
description.en: Agents carry, trade and use items in backpacks.

description.zh: 向背包添加、移除、列出物品，并管理容量与负重。
description.en: Adds, removes and lists backpack items with capacity and weight.

description.zh: 向背包添加物品（受容量与负重约束）。
description.en: Adds items to the backpack, enforcing capacity and weight limits.

description.zh: 从背包移除物品（数量不足抛出）。
description.en: Removes items from the backpack (throws if insufficient).

description.zh: 列出某居民背包内容（件数、重量、容量）。
description.en: Lists a resident's backpack (count, weight, capacity).

description.zh: 读取 / 设置背包容量与负重上限。
description.en: Reads or sets the backpack capacity and max weight.

description.zh: 定义物品的类别、属性与用途。
description.en: Defines item categories, properties and uses.

description.zh: 定义（幂等）一个物品类型，未给 id 时用 infra.identity 生成有序 id。
description.en: Defines (idempotently) an item type, generating an ordered id via infra.identity when absent.

description.zh: 查询物品目录：全部 / 按 id / 按 category。
description.en: Queries the item catalog: all, by id, or by category.

description.zh: 管理智能体的出生、衰老与死亡，驱动小镇代际更替。
description.en: Manages birth, aging and death to drive generational turnover.

description.zh: 调用 agent.lifecycle.birth。
description.en: Calls agent.lifecycle.birth.

description.zh: 调用 agent.lifecycle.age。
description.en: Calls agent.lifecycle.age.

description.zh: 调用 agent.lifecycle.death。
description.en: Calls agent.lifecycle.death.

description.zh: 保存情景与语义记忆，为决策和社交提供经验背景。
description.en: Stores episodic and semantic memory for decision and social context.

description.zh: 记录和召回具体事件及其情感标记。
description.en: Stores and recalls specific events with emotional markers.

description.zh: 按标签与时间窗口召回情景记忆，并按显著性/时间/标签重合排序。
description.en: Recalls episodic memories by tag/time window, ranked by salience/recency/tag overlap.

description.zh: 按 tags/since/limit 召回某智能体的情景记忆。
description.en: Recalls memories filtered by tags/since/limit.

description.zh: 按显著性 + 时间衰减 + 标签重合对记忆排序并返回分数。
description.en: Ranks memories by salience + recency + tag overlap with scores.

description.zh: 写入并标注带情感标记的情景事件，支持标签合并与列表查询。
description.en: Writes/tags episodic events with emotional markers, plus list queries.

description.zh: 写入一条情景记忆（自动生成或使用指定 id）并返回快照。
description.en: Writes an episodic memory (auto or explicit id) returning a snapshot.

description.zh: 为已有情景记忆追加标签（幂等合并去重）。
description.en: Appends tags to an existing memory (idempotent dedupe).

description.zh: 沉淀语义记忆条目（事件→摘要），按词面/标签相关度召回（默认纯词面匹配，不依赖 MiniLM）。
description.en: Stores semantic memory entries (event→summary) and recalls them by lexical/tag relevance (default lexical matching, no MiniLM).

description.zh: 写入一条语义记忆（事件→摘要），每主体上限裁剪。
description.en: Stores one semantic memory entry (event→summary) with per-agent cap.

description.zh: 按词面/标签相关度召回语义记忆（top-K）。
description.en: Recalls semantic memories by lexical/tag relevance (top-K).

description.zh: 定义智能体的身份、性格与动机，为提示词和行为生成提供稳定人格底座。
description.en: Defines agent identity, personality and motivations as the stable basis for prompts and behavior.

description.zh: 描述智能体的姓名、年龄、职业与自我叙事。
description.en: Describes name, age, occupation and self-narrative.

description.zh: 调用 agent.persona.identity.describe。
description.en: Calls agent.persona.identity.describe.

description.zh: 调用 agent.persona.identity.update。
description.en: Calls agent.persona.identity.update.

description.zh: 评估需求、目标与情绪驱动力，输出行动优先级。
description.en: Evaluates needs, goals and emotional drives to rank action priorities.

description.zh: 调用 agent.persona.motivation.evaluate。
description.en: Calls agent.persona.motivation.evaluate.

description.zh: 调用 agent.persona.motivation.rank。
description.en: Calls agent.persona.motivation.rank.

description.zh: 用大五人格等维度刻画性格，并评估情境下的行为倾向。
description.en: Profiles personality traits and evaluates situational behavioral tendencies.

description.zh: 调用 agent.persona.personality.profile。
description.en: Calls agent.persona.personality.profile.

description.zh: 调用 agent.persona.personality.evaluate。
description.en: Calls agent.persona.personality.evaluate.

description.zh: 创伤、应对与精神崩溃：智能体在压力下会变形，而不只是消耗资源。
description.en: Trauma, coping and breakdown: agents bend under pressure instead of merely consuming resources.

description.zh: 创伤积累到阈值后触发崩溃，决策质量下降，极端时走向死亡。
description.en: Triggers breakdown past a trauma threshold, degrading decisions or ending in death.

description.zh: 调用 agent.psyche.break.check。
description.en: Calls agent.psyche.break.check.

description.zh: 调用 agent.psyche.break.trigger。
description.en: Calls agent.psyche.break.trigger.

description.zh: 选择并执行祈祷、写作、社交、酗酒等应对行为。
description.en: Chooses and executes coping behaviors such as prayer, writing, socializing or drinking.

description.zh: 调用 agent.psyche.coping.choose。
description.en: Calls agent.psyche.coping.choose.

description.zh: 调用 agent.psyche.coping.execute。
description.en: Calls agent.psyche.coping.execute.

label.zh: 读取特质选择应对方式

description.zh: 记录亲人死亡、饥荒、冲突等造成的心理创伤并支持疗愈。
description.en: Records trauma from deaths, famine and conflict, with healing support.

description.zh: 调用 agent.psyche.trauma.add。
description.en: Calls agent.psyche.trauma.add.

description.zh: 调用 agent.psyche.trauma.query。
description.en: Calls agent.psyche.trauma.query.

description.zh: 调用 agent.psyche.trauma.heal。
description.en: Calls agent.psyche.trauma.heal.

label.zh: 读取生存压力累积创伤

description.zh: 让智能体承担职业与公共角色，嵌入小镇分工。
description.en: Assigns occupational and civic roles to embed agents in the town.

description.zh: 分配与释放职业身份，连接就业市场与产业。
description.en: Assigns and releases occupations linked to labour and industry.

description.zh: 调用 agent.role.career.assign。
description.en: Calls agent.role.career.assign.

description.zh: 调用 agent.role.career.release。
description.en: Calls agent.role.career.release.

description.zh: 承担镇长、店主、居民等公共身份并参与治理。
description.en: Holds civic identities such as mayor, shopkeeper or resident.

description.zh: 调用 agent.role.society.hold。
description.en: Calls agent.role.society.hold.

description.zh: 调用 agent.role.society.retire。
description.en: Calls agent.role.society.retire.

description.zh: 生成并执行智能体的每日日程，使行为有节奏地展开。
description.en: Generates and executes daily schedules for rhythmic behavior.

description.zh: 按世界时间推进日程项，触发对应行动。
description.en: Advances schedule items by world time and triggers actions.

description.zh: 调用 agent.schedule.executor.start。
description.en: Calls agent.schedule.executor.start.

description.zh: 调用 agent.schedule.executor.tick。
description.en: Calls agent.schedule.executor.tick.

description.zh: 根据角色、目标与约束生成和重排日程。
description.en: Generates and replans schedules from roles, goals and constraints.

description.zh: 调用 agent.schedule.planner.generate。
description.en: Calls agent.schedule.planner.generate.

description.zh: 调用 agent.schedule.planner.replan。
description.en: Calls agent.schedule.planner.replan.

description.zh: 每个智能体由 50 个 tag 组成特质串，支持采样、遗传组合与变异演化。
description.en: Each agent carries 50 tags, with sampling, inheritance and mutation.

description.zh: 让 tag 发生小概率变异并随时间漂移，推动代际更新。
description.en: Applies rare mutation and temporal drift to evolve tags across generations.

description.zh: 调用 agent.traits.evolution.mutate。
description.en: Calls agent.traits.evolution.mutate.

description.zh: 调用 agent.traits.evolution.drift。
description.en: Calls agent.traits.evolution.drift.

description.zh: 从父本母本各 50 个 tag 中随机组合出子代 50 个 tag。
description.en: Combines 50 tags from each parent into a child set of 50 tags.

description.zh: 从父本母本标签按比例随机组合出子代标签集，子代 key 唯一。
description.en: Combines paternal/maternal tags into a unique child tag set by ratio.

description.zh: 按 paternalRatio 组合父本母本标签，生成 size（默认 50）个子代标签。
description.en: Combines parents into size child tags (default 50) by paternalRatio.

description.zh: 统计子代标签来自父本/母本/共有/新变异的计数与比例。
description.en: Counts paternal/maternal/shared/novel inheritance ratios.

description.zh: 校验子代标签串的合法性（数量/唯一/权重），并审计继承比例。
description.en: Validates child tag legality (count/uniqueness/weights) and audits inheritance ratio.

description.zh: 校验标签集数量、key 唯一性与权重合法性，返回 {ok, errors}。
description.en: Validates count, key uniqueness and weights; returns {ok, errors}.

description.zh: 审计子代继承/新变异比例并给出 plausible 判断。
description.en: Audits inherited/novel ratio and gives a plausibility verdict.

description.zh: 读写智能体的 50 个特质标签，支持加权采样与相似度计算。
description.en: Reads/writes the 50 tags and supports weighted sampling and similarity.

description.zh: 按权重随机采样特质标签，支持无放回抽取与单标签取样，随机源可 seed 复现。
description.en: Weighted-samples trait tags without replacement, reproducible via a seeded RNG.

description.zh: 从某智能体标签集按权重抽取 1 个标签；无标签返回 null。
description.en: Samples one tag from an agent set; null when empty.

description.zh: 按权重无放回抽取 n 个标签（默认 1）。
description.en: Samples n distinct tags by weight without replacement (default 1).

description.zh: 计算两个 50 标签集合的相似度并检索近邻。
description.en: Computes similarity between two 50-tag sets and finds neighbors.

description.zh: 调用 agent.traits.tagset.similarity.compare。
description.en: Calls agent.traits.tagset.similarity.compare.

description.zh: 调用 agent.traits.tagset.similarity.neighbors。
description.en: Calls agent.traits.tagset.similarity.neighbors.

description.zh: 持久化读写单个智能体的特质标签集（默认 50 个），支持对象或数组输入，读写均深拷贝隔离。
description.en: Persists an agent trait tag set (50 by default), accepting map or array input, with deep-copy isolation.

description.zh: 读取指定智能体的特质标签集；不存在返回 null。
description.en: Reads an agent tag set; returns null when missing.

description.zh: 写入（upsert）智能体的特质标签集并返回规范化快照。
description.en: Upserts an agent tag set and returns the normalized snapshot.

description.zh: 为智能体提供 LLM 推理、提示词构建、思维与对话生成、记忆向量与安全护栏。
description.en: Provides LLM inference, prompt building, thought/speech generation, memory vectors and safety guardrails.

description.zh: 让真实大模型从居民当前可行候选集内选择行动，是「有模型 E2E」的入口：状态→候选集→模型选择→行动执行。模型不得新增行动或绕过可行性约束，解析失败或越界时回落确定性结果并记录原因。
description.en: Lets a real LLM pick an action from the agent feasible candidate set; the LLM-in-the-loop entry point. No invented actions or bypassed feasibility.

description.zh: 组装决策提示词：处境 + 候选行动（含可行性理由）。
description.en: Builds the decision prompt with situation and candidates.

description.zh: 从模型自由文本中提取行动名，容忍标点/引号/大小写/前后缀。
description.en: Extracts an action name from free-form model text.

description.zh: 调用模型做一次行动选择，返回 action 与调用元数据。
description.en: Calls the model once to choose an action.

description.zh: 检查生成内容的安全性与世界观一致性。
description.en: Checks generated content for safety and worldview consistency.

description.zh: 调用 ai.guard.check。
description.en: Calls ai.guard.check.

description.zh: 调用 ai.guard.sanitize。
description.en: Calls ai.guard.sanitize.

description.zh: 接入本地 LAYA 结构化判断服务，把处境紧迫度交给语义模型而非固定阈值。它是压力分的语义分量（15%），不是决定者：服务不可用时静默回退，默认关闭。
description.en: Optional LAYA structured-judgement client contributing a semantic share of the pressure score; never the decider, silent fallback, off by default.

description.zh: 发起一次 LAYA 结构化判断，按状态键缓存。
description.en: Issues one LAYA judgement with state-key caching.

description.zh: 把居民的饥饿与储备处境交给语义模型，返回紧迫度 0..1。
description.en: Returns a 0..1 urgency for a resident state.

description.zh: 从 score 型的概率分布聚合出期望档位。
description.en: Aggregates an expected score from probabilities.

description.zh: 调用与命中与失败与延迟快照。
description.en: Call, hit, failure and latency snapshot.

description.zh: 统一接入语言模型，支持补全、嵌入与路由。
description.en: Unified LLM access for completion, embedding and routing.

description.zh: 执行补全与嵌入请求，处理限流与重试。
description.en: Executes completion and embedding requests with rate limiting and retries.

description.zh: 执行一次 LLM 补全请求，支持可插拔 provider，内置限流与指数退避重试。
description.en: Executes an LLM completion request with pluggable providers, rate limiting and exponential-backoff retries.

description.zh: 把文本列表编码为向量，返回确定性或模型生成的嵌入。
description.en: Encodes a list of texts into vectors, returning deterministic or model-generated embeddings.

description.zh: 按任务类型选择模型并提供降级路由。
description.en: Routes tasks to models with fallback policies.

description.zh: 按任务类型选择 provider 与模型，返回路由决策。
description.en: Selects a provider and model by task type, returning a routing decision.

description.zh: 沿 provider 列表降级尝试补全/嵌入，前一个失败自动切到下一个。
description.en: Degrades across the provider list for completion/embedding, falling back on failure.

description.zh: 对记忆做向量化编码、检索与压缩摘要。
description.en: Encodes, retrieves and summarizes memory as vectors.

description.zh: 把情景与语义记忆编码为向量并检索相似记忆。
description.en: Encodes memory to vectors and searches similar memories.

description.zh: 调用 ai.memory.embedding.encode。
description.en: Calls ai.memory.embedding.encode.

description.zh: 调用 ai.memory.embedding.search。
description.en: Calls ai.memory.embedding.search.

description.zh: 把长段记忆压缩为结构化摘要。
description.en: Compresses long memories into structured summaries.

description.zh: 调用 ai.memory.summary.compress。
description.en: Calls ai.memory.summary.compress.

description.zh: 为智能体与世界观组装结构化提示词。
description.en: Assembles structured prompts for agents and the world.

description.zh: 用 50 标签、人设与记忆组装智能体提示词。
description.en: Assembles agent prompts from 50 tags, persona and memory.

description.zh: 用 50 标签、人设与记忆组装智能体结构化提示词（system/user/messages）。
description.en: Assembles a structured agent prompt (system/user/messages) from tags, persona and memory.

description.zh: 校验提示词安全性（MVP 内置护栏：筛查提示注入），返回 issues 与净化文本。
description.en: Validates prompt safety (MVP inline guard for prompt injection), returning issues and sanitized text.

description.zh: 组装小镇世界观、规则与空间背景提示词。
description.en: Assembles town worldview, rules and spatial context prompts.

description.zh: 调用 ai.prompt.world.compose。
description.en: Calls ai.prompt.world.compose.

description.zh: 生成社交平台与面对面交流的对话内容。
description.en: Generates dialogue for social platforms and face-to-face talk.

description.zh: 调用 ai.speech.generate。
description.en: Calls ai.speech.generate.

description.zh: 调用 ai.speech.polish。
description.en: Calls ai.speech.polish.

description.zh: 生成智能体内心思考与行动反思。
description.en: Generates agent thoughts and reflections.

description.zh: 生成智能体在当前处境下的内心思考。
description.en: Generates the agent's inner thought for the current situation.

description.zh: 让智能体对刚执行完的行动与结果做反思。
description.en: Reflects on a just-executed action and its outcome.

description.zh: 向观测者与控制台提供模拟控制、状态查询、可视化与存档接口。
description.en: Provides control, state query, visualization and archive APIs for observers and consoles.

description.zh: 保存与加载沙盘存档。
description.en: Saves and loads sandbox archives.

description.zh: 保存当前沙盘存档。
description.en: Saves the current archive.

description.zh: 加载指定沙盘存档。
description.en: Loads a specified archive.

description.zh: 启动、暂停与步进模拟。
description.en: Starts, pauses and steps the simulation.

description.zh: 启动模拟主循环（缺省初始化 3 个居民并置为 running）。
description.en: Starts the simulation loop (spawns 3 residents by default and enters running).

description.zh: 暂停模拟主循环（置为 paused）。
description.en: Pauses the simulation loop (enters paused).

description.zh: 推进一个完整 tick 闭环并返回本次摘要。
description.en: Advances one full tick of the loop and returns its summary.

description.zh: 列出全部难度档位（含参数与预期表现 + current 标记）。
description.en: Lists all difficulty presets (params + expected survival + current flag).

description.zh: 查询当前难度档位。
description.en: Queries the current difficulty preset.

description.zh: 切换难度档位（切换后新建的 run 生效）。
description.en: Switches the difficulty preset (applies to the next run).

description.zh: 查询世界状态与智能体详情。
description.en: Queries world state and agent details.

description.zh: 获取当前世界状态快照（tick / 资源 / 需求 / 编年计数）。
description.en: Gets the current world-state snapshot (tick / resources / needs / chronicle counts).

description.zh: 获取智能体详情（实体信息 + 需求 + 最近决策/行为日志）。
description.en: Gets agent details (entity info + needs + recent decision/action logs).

description.zh: 提供沙盘可视化单页入口。
description.en: Serves the sandbox visualization page.

description.zh: 返回沙盘可视化页面。
description.en: Returns the sandbox viewer page.

description.zh: 文明状态、技术树、崩溃判定与重启：崩溃后把历史、技术与遗物归档为文明遗产，重启沙盒并继承给下一代文明。
description.en: Civilization state, tech tree, collapse detection and restart: after collapse, history, technology and relics are archived as legacy for the next civilization.

description.zh: 把文明遗产与全部历史存档，供重启后读取。
description.en: Archives the legacy and full history for post-restart access.

description.zh: 调用 civilization.archive.save。
description.en: Calls civilization.archive.save.

description.zh: 调用 civilization.archive.load。
description.en: Calls civilization.archive.load.

description.zh: 判定文明是否发生集体性崩溃。
description.en: Detects collective civilizational collapse.

description.zh: 确认集体性崩溃并写入观察者日志。
description.en: Confirms collective collapse and writes the observer log.

description.zh: 调用 civilization.collapse.confirmer.confirm。
description.en: Calls civilization.collapse.confirmer.confirm.

description.zh: 调用 civilization.collapse.confirmer.override。
description.en: Calls civilization.collapse.confirmer.override.

description.zh: 汇总生存危机与文明状态指标，检测崩溃信号。
description.en: Detects collapse signals from survival crisis and civilization metrics.

description.zh: 调用 civilization.collapse.detector.detect。
description.en: Calls civilization.collapse.detector.detect.

description.zh: 调用 civilization.collapse.detector.indicators。
description.en: Calls civilization.collapse.detector.indicators.

description.zh: 为已崩溃文明生成历史图谱与 200-500 字描述，供下一代文明继承。
description.en: Builds a history graph and a 200-500 word description of a collapsed civilization for the next one to inherit.

description.zh: 把当前文明的全部历史和所作所为汇总为知识图谱。
description.en: Summarizes all history and deeds of the current civilization into a knowledge graph.

description.zh: 调用 civilization.legacy.graph.build。
description.en: Calls civilization.legacy.graph.build.

description.zh: 调用 civilization.legacy.graph.query。
description.en: Calls civilization.legacy.graph.query.

description.zh: 生成 200-500 字的文明遗产描述文本。
description.en: Generates a 200-500 word civilization legacy description.

description.zh: 从历史图谱提取关键事件、人物与成就。
description.en: Extracts key events, people and deeds from the legacy graph.

description.zh: 调用 civilization.legacy.summary.extractor.extract。
description.en: Calls civilization.legacy.summary.extractor.extract.

description.zh: 调用 civilization.legacy.summary.extractor.events。
description.en: Calls civilization.legacy.summary.extractor.events.

description.zh: 用 LLM 生成 200-500 字文明遗产描述。
description.en: Generates a 200-500 word legacy description via LLM.

description.zh: 调用 civilization.legacy.summary.writer.generate。
description.en: Calls civilization.legacy.summary.writer.generate.

description.zh: 调用 civilization.legacy.summary.writer.constrain。
description.en: Calls civilization.legacy.summary.writer.constrain.

description.zh: 上一代文明的物品、建筑与书籍留在下一代世界里，成为可被发现的遗物。
description.en: Artifacts, structures and books of past civilizations remain for the next to discover.

description.zh: 把上一代文明的物品、建筑与书籍固化为遗物并持久化。
description.en: Turns past items, buildings and books into persistent relics.

description.zh: 调用 civilization.relic.artifact.create。
description.en: Calls civilization.relic.artifact.create.

description.zh: 调用 civilization.relic.artifact.persist。
description.en: Calls civilization.relic.artifact.persist.

description.zh: 新一代智能体在土地上挖掘并解读遗物，把旧文明知识带回来。
description.en: New agents excavate and interpret relics, bringing old knowledge back.

description.zh: 调用 civilization.relic.discover.find。
description.en: Calls civilization.relic.discover.find.

description.zh: 调用 civilization.relic.discover.interpret。
description.en: Calls civilization.relic.discover.interpret.

description.zh: 执行沙盒重启，并把上一代文明遗产注入新文明。
description.en: Restarts the sandbox and injects the previous civilization's legacy into the new one.

description.zh: 调用 civilization.restart.execute。
description.en: Calls civilization.restart.execute.

description.zh: 调用 civilization.restart.inherit。
description.en: Calls civilization.restart.inherit.

description.zh: 统计人口、资源、存活时长等文明健康度指标。
description.en: Tracks civilization health metrics: population, resources and survival time.

description.zh: 调用 civilization.state.metrics。
description.en: Calls civilization.state.metrics.

description.zh: 调用 civilization.state.survival_time。
description.en: Calls civilization.state.survival_time.

description.zh: 技术树、研究与技术遗忘：文明有了长期记忆，存活时长不只靠运气。
description.en: Tech tree, research and knowledge loss: civilizations gain long-term memory.

description.zh: 当掌握者死亡且无人继承时，技术节点被锁定甚至遗忘。
description.en: Locks or forgets tech nodes when their holders die without successors.

description.zh: 检测技术是否失传（掌握者全部死亡且无继承）。
description.en: Detects tech loss (holders all dead with no successor).

description.zh: 锁定（失传）技术使其不可用，并写观察日志。
description.en: Applies the loss, locking the tech and logging.

description.zh: 由工程师、医生等职业角色推进研究进度并完成技术突破。
description.en: Advances research progress by engineers, doctors and other roles to complete breakthroughs.

description.zh: 开始一项技术研究（校验前置 / 资源，登记任务）。
description.en: Starts researching a tech (validates prerequisites and registers a task).

description.zh: 推进研究 n 个 tick，每 tick 消耗能源并累计进度。
description.en: Advances research by n ticks, consuming energy and accumulating progress.

description.zh: 进度达标后完成技术突破并解锁技术。
description.en: Completes the breakthrough and unlocks the tech once progress is met.

description.zh: 查询、解锁与锁定净水、温室、发电、医疗、通信等技术节点。
description.en: Queries, unlocks and locks tech nodes like water purification, greenhouses, power, medicine and comms.

description.zh: 查询单个或全部技术节点（状态 / 前置 / 成本 / 掌握者）。
description.en: Queries one or all tech nodes (state / prerequisites / cost / holders).

description.zh: 解锁技术节点（要求全部前置已解锁），记录掌握者并写观察日志。
description.en: Unlocks a tech node (all prerequisites unlocked), records holders and logs.

description.zh: 锁定（失传）技术节点使其不可用，并写观察日志。
description.en: Locks (forgets) a tech node making it unavailable, and logs.

description.zh: 小镇内循环经济：账户、交易、市场、产业、银行、破产与税收。
description.en: Closed-loop economy: accounts, transactions, markets, industry, banking, bankruptcy and tax.

description.zh: 提供信贷与利息，形成资金跨期配置。
description.en: Provides credit and interest for intertemporal allocation of money.

description.zh: 申请与偿还贷款，支持创业与消费。
description.en: Applies for and repays loans for business and consumption.

description.zh: 申请贷款（银行金库→借款人真实转账，记录额度/期限/状态）。
description.en: Applies for a loan (bank-treasury-to-borrower transfer, records principal/term/status).

description.zh: 偿还贷款（借款人→银行金库真实转账）。
description.en: Repays a loan (borrower-to-bank-treasury transfer).

description.zh: 开设银行金库账户并注入初始资本。
description.en: Opens the bank treasury account with initial capital.

description.zh: 按账户余额与贷款计息并结算。
description.en: Accrues and settles interest on deposits and loans.

description.zh: 对单笔贷款计息一次（单利/复利，仅增债务不造钱）。
description.en: Accrues interest once on a loan (simple/compound, debt-only).

description.zh: 对全部在途贷款各计息一次。
description.en: Accrues interest on all active loans.

description.zh: 对资不抵债的智能体或企业启动破产与清算。
description.en: Files and liquidates insolvent agents or businesses.

description.zh: 调用 economy.bankruptcy.file。
description.en: Calls economy.bankruptcy.file.

description.zh: 调用 economy.bankruptcy.liquidate。
description.en: Calls economy.bankruptcy.liquidate.

description.zh: 智能体可创办和经营企业，雇佣劳动并组织生产。
description.en: Agents found and run businesses, hire labour and organize production.

description.zh: 创办、运营与关闭企业，构成小镇产业组成。
description.en: Founds, operates and closes businesses as town industries.

description.zh: 调用 economy.industry.business.found。
description.en: Calls economy.industry.business.found.

description.zh: 调用 economy.industry.business.operate。
description.en: Calls economy.industry.business.operate.

description.zh: 调用 economy.industry.business.close。
description.en: Calls economy.industry.business.close.

description.zh: 发布职位、雇佣与发薪，连接智能体职业与经济。
description.en: Posts jobs, hires and pays wages linking careers to economy.

description.zh: 调用 economy.industry.labour.hire。
description.en: Calls economy.industry.labour.hire.

description.zh: 调用 economy.industry.labour.pay。
description.en: Calls economy.industry.labour.pay.

description.zh: 制定生产计划并产出商品与服务。
description.en: Plans production and outputs goods and services.

description.zh: 调用 economy.industry.production.plan。
description.en: Calls economy.industry.production.plan.

description.zh: 调用 economy.industry.production.output。
description.en: Calls economy.industry.production.output.

description.zh: 管理智能体与企业账户及交易流水。
description.en: Manages accounts and transaction records for agents and businesses.

description.zh: 开户、查询余额与销户，承载货币持有。
description.en: Opens, queries and closes money accounts.

description.zh: 开户（可选指定 owner 与初始余额）。
description.en: Opens an account (optional owner and initial balance).

description.zh: 查询账户余额。
description.en: Queries an account balance.

description.zh: 销户（标记关闭，保留余额供审计）。
description.en: Closes an account (keeps balance for audit).

description.zh: 记录并查询转账、消费与收入流水。
description.en: Posts and queries transfers, spending and income.

description.zh: 查询与审计交易流水。
description.en: Queries and audits transaction records.

description.zh: 按账户/来源/去向/区间等条件查询流水。
description.en: Queries transactions by account/source/target/range.

description.zh: 对账户重放流水并对账，返回一致性结论。
description.en: Replays transactions for an account and reports consistency.

description.zh: 记录交易流水并发布事件。
description.en: Records transactions and publishes events.

description.zh: 记录一笔转账（校验→落账→写流水→发事件），返回回执。
description.en: Records a transfer (validate→settle→append→publish), returns a receipt.

description.zh: 按流水 ID 取回回执。
description.en: Fetches a receipt by transaction id.

description.zh: 校验账户余额与交易原子性。
description.en: Validates balances and transaction atomicity.

description.zh: 校验单笔转账的余额充足性与账户有效性。
description.en: Validates balance sufficiency and account validity of a single transfer.

description.zh: 校验批量转账原子性（任一步透支即整体失败）。
description.en: Validates atomicity of a batch of transfers (any overdraft fails the whole batch).

description.zh: 撮合买卖订单并形成价格，让商品与服务流通。
description.en: Matches orders and forms prices for circulating goods and services.

description.zh: 挂单、撤单与撮合买卖。
description.en: Places, cancels and matches buy/sell orders.

description.zh: 撮合买卖订单并调用账本结算。
description.en: Matches orders and settles via the ledger.

description.zh: 撮合某 symbol 的买卖单（价格/时间优先，只读）。
description.en: Matches buy/sell orders for a symbol (price-time priority, read-only).

description.zh: 结算交易（落账、扣减订单、回写价格）。
description.en: Settles trades (settle, reduce orders, update price).

description.zh: 挂单与撤单，维护买卖订单集合。
description.en: Places and cancels buy/sell orders.

description.zh: 挂单（校验账户与价格/数量合法性）。
description.en: Places an order (validates account and price/quantity).

description.zh: 撤单（标记 cancelled）。
description.en: Cancels an open order.

description.zh: 报价并依据供需更新价格。
description.en: Quotes and updates prices by supply and demand.

description.zh: 查询某 symbol 当前价格。
description.en: Quotes the current price for a symbol.

description.zh: 更新（发现）某 symbol 价格。
description.en: Updates (discovers) a symbol's price.

description.zh: 征收税款并再分配以维持公共设施与福利。
description.en: Collects and redistributes taxes for public goods and welfare.

description.zh: 按余额/交易征税并转入税收池（真实转账）。
description.en: Collects tax on balances/transactions into the pool.

description.zh: 把税收池余额按人头或公共支出再分配（守恒）。
description.en: Redistributes the tax pool per capita or to public spending.

description.zh: 开设税收池账户（余额 0）。
description.en: Opens the tax pool account (balance 0).

description.zh: 生成初始小镇与智能体，并通过遗传与提示词组装实现代际更新。
description.en: Creates the initial town and agents, and renews generations through heredity and prompt assembly.

description.zh: 从模板与组装流程创建可运行的新智能体。
description.en: Creates runnable new agents from templates and assembly.

description.zh: 组装并注册新智能体到沙盘运行时。
description.en: Assembles and registers new agents into the runtime.

description.zh: 调用 genesis.agent_factory.assemble.create。
description.en: Calls genesis.agent_factory.assemble.create.

description.zh: 调用 genesis.agent_factory.assemble.register。
description.en: Calls genesis.agent_factory.assemble.register.

description.zh: 从特质与角色构建智能体模板。
description.en: Builds agent templates from traits and roles.

description.zh: 调用 genesis.agent_factory.template.build。
description.en: Calls genesis.agent_factory.template.build.

description.zh: 调用 genesis.agent_factory.template.instantiate。
description.en: Calls genesis.agent_factory.template.instantiate.

description.zh: 从父本母本 100 个 tag 重组出子代 50 个 tag，并组装新提示词。
description.en: Recombines 100 parental tags into 50 child tags and assembles a new prompt.

description.zh: 把子代特质、家庭背景与小镇世界观组装成新智能体提示词。
description.en: Assembles child traits, family context and town worldview into a new agent prompt.

description.zh: 调用 genesis.heredity.prompt.assemble。
description.en: Calls genesis.heredity.prompt.assemble.

description.zh: 随机从父母双方 100 个 tag 中抽取 50 个组成子代特质串。
description.en: Randomly samples 50 tags from 100 parental tags for the child.

description.zh: 调用 genesis.heredity.tags.combine。
description.en: Calls genesis.heredity.tags.combine.

description.zh: 调用 genesis.heredity.tags.validate。
description.en: Calls genesis.heredity.tags.validate.

description.zh: 评估人口、产业与空间结构并替换消亡个体，保持小镇自主更新。
description.en: Evaluates population, industry and space, replacing the dead to renew the town.

description.zh: 调用 genesis.renewal.evaluate。
description.en: Calls genesis.renewal.evaluate.

description.zh: 调用 genesis.renewal.replace。
description.en: Calls genesis.renewal.replace.

description.zh: 创建初始小镇空间、设施与首批智能体。
description.en: Creates initial town spaces, facilities and founding agents.

description.zh: 调用 genesis.world_factory.create_town。
description.en: Calls genesis.world_factory.create_town.

description.zh: 调用 genesis.world_factory.create_agents。
description.en: Calls genesis.world_factory.create_agents.

description.zh: 事件总线、持久化存储、ID、随机数、配置与日志等底层支撑。
description.en: Event bus, persistence, identity, randomness, config and logging foundations.

description.zh: 统一读写沙盘运行参数（点分 key，持久化到图存储），并提供外提参数的默认值快照（defaults）、校验（validate）与合并（resolve）。
description.en: Reads and writes sandbox runtime parameters (dotted keys, persisted into the graph store), and exposes a defaults snapshot, validation and merge for externalized parameters.

description.zh: 读取全部或指定 key 的沙盘运行参数。
description.en: Reads all or a specific sandbox runtime parameter by key.

description.zh: 写入单个运行参数（key/value），持久化到图存储。
description.en: Writes a single runtime parameter (key/value), persisted into the graph store.

description.zh: 批量合并运行参数（对象形式）。
description.en: Bulk-merges runtime parameters (object form).

description.zh: 返回全部外提参数的默认值快照（深拷贝）。
description.en: Returns a deep-copied snapshot of all externalized parameter defaults.

description.zh: 校验一组参数覆盖（只校验已知键，忽略未知键）。
description.en: Validates a set of parameter overrides (known keys only, unknown keys ignored).

description.zh: 把参数覆盖深度合并到默认值并校验，返回生效配置。
description.en: Deep-merges overrides onto defaults and validates, returning the effective config.

description.zh: 返回全部可用难度档位 id。
description.en: Returns all available difficulty preset ids.

description.zh: 返回全部难度档位深拷贝（含参数与预期表现）。
description.en: Returns a deep copy of all difficulty presets (params + expected survival).

description.zh: 返回指定档位的运行参数（未知档位返回 null）。
description.en: Returns a preset's run parameters (null for unknown id).

description.zh: 返回当前难度档位快照（id/label/expected/params）。
description.en: Returns the current difficulty snapshot (id/label/expected/params).

description.zh: 切换当前难度档位（未知档位抛 RangeError）。
description.en: Switches the current difficulty preset (RangeError on unknown id).

description.zh: 返回当前档位运行参数（供 loop 叠加为基础参数）。
description.en: Returns the current preset run params (used as base params by the loop).

description.zh: 在小镇各模块间发布与订阅事件，并支持重试。
description.en: Publishes and subscribes events across modules with retries.

description.zh: 发布与订阅沙盘事件。
description.en: Publishes and subscribes to sandbox events.

description.zh: 向主题派发事件，同步调用全部匹配订阅者。
description.en: Publishes an event to a topic, synchronously invoking all matching subscribers.

description.zh: 订阅主题并返回取消订阅函数；topic "*" 订阅全部。
description.en: Subscribes to a topic and returns an unsubscribe function; topic "*" matches all.

description.zh: 对失败事件入队重试与死信处理。
description.en: Retries failed events and handles dead letters.

description.zh: 调用 infra.events.retry.enqueue。
description.en: Calls infra.events.retry.enqueue.

description.zh: 调用 infra.events.retry.run。
description.en: Calls infra.events.retry.run.

description.zh: 生成全局唯一且有序的实体 ID。
description.en: Generates globally unique, ordered entity IDs.

description.zh: 生成下一个全局唯一且有序的实体 ID（可带类别前缀）。
description.en: Generates the next globally unique, ordered entity ID (with optional type prefix).

description.zh: 提供可复现的随机数与种子管理。
description.en: Provides reproducible randomness and seed management.

description.zh: 固定随机源；同一 seed 保证随机序列可复现。
description.en: Fixes the random source; the same seed reproduces the same sequence.

description.zh: 返回 [0,1) 区间的均匀伪随机浮点数。
description.en: Returns a uniform pseudo-random float in [0,1).

description.zh: 图、向量与存档数据的持久化。
description.en: Persists graph, vector and archive data.

description.zh: 保存与加载完整沙盘存档。
description.en: Saves and loads full sandbox archives.

description.zh: 调用 infra.store.archive.save。
description.en: Calls infra.store.archive.save.

description.zh: 调用 infra.store.archive.load。
description.en: Calls infra.store.archive.load.

description.zh: 读写社交图与空间拓扑等图数据。
description.en: Reads and writes graph data such as social and spatial topology.

description.zh: 幂等写入（upsert）一个图节点及其出向边。
description.en: Idempotently upserts a graph node and its outgoing edges.

description.zh: 按 id / type 读取图节点，或读取全部节点。
description.en: Reads graph nodes by id / type, or returns all nodes.

description.zh: 写入与检索记忆向量。
description.en: Upserts and searches memory vectors.

description.zh: 调用 infra.store.vector.upsert。
description.en: Calls infra.store.vector.upsert.

description.zh: 调用 infra.store.vector.search。
description.en: Calls infra.store.vector.search.

description.zh: 记录每个智能体的每一次决策与每一个行为，形成编年志，并提供回放、反事实与跨文明对比实验。
description.en: Records every decision and action into chronicles, with replay, counterfactual and cross-civilization comparison experiments.

description.zh: 回溯单个智能体的决策链，并对比不同个体的行为差异。
description.en: Traces individual decision chains and compares behavior across agents.

description.zh: 调用 observer.audit.trace。
description.en: Calls observer.audit.trace.

description.zh: 调用 observer.audit.compare。
description.en: Calls observer.audit.compare.

description.zh: 把原始行为日志编译为按时间组织的编年志。
description.en: Compiles raw logs into a time-organized chronicle.

description.zh: 把原始决策/行为/事件日志按时间桶编译为编年志。
description.en: Compiles raw decision/action/event logs into a time-bucketed chronicle.

description.zh: 读取原始日志并编译为按时间组织的编年志（含计数、分桶与时间线）。
description.en: Reads raw logs and compiles a time-organized chronicle (counts, buckets and timeline).

description.zh: 把日志条目按 tick 分桶（支持自定义桶大小）。
description.en: Buckets log entries by tick with a configurable bucket size.

description.zh: 查询与范围读取编年志。
description.en: Queries and range-reads chronicles.

description.zh: 调用 observer.chronicle.store.query。
description.en: Calls observer.chronicle.store.query.

description.zh: 调用 observer.chronicle.store.range。
description.en: Calls observer.chronicle.store.range.

description.zh: 回放、反事实与跨文明对比，让我们不只记录，还能做跨文明研究。
description.en: Replay, counterfactuals and cross-civilization comparison for research beyond recording.

description.zh: 比较历代文明的存活时长、崩溃方式与遗产，只读文明存档。
description.en: Compares survival times, collapse modes and legacies across civilizations; read-only over archives.

description.zh: 读取全部文明存档并按存活时长降序返回。
description.en: Reads all civ archives sorted by survival desc.

description.zh: 对存档记录做存活/崩溃/遗产聚合统计。
description.en: Aggregates survival/collapse/legacy metrics over archive records.

description.zh: 以已记录决策为锚点创建反事实分支并比较"如果当时不这样做"的差异，只读。
description.en: Branches counterfactual alternatives anchored on recorded decisions and compares what-if divergences; read-only.

description.zh: 以已记录决策为锚点创建反事实分支。
description.en: Creates a counterfactual branch anchored on a recorded decision.

description.zh: 比较原决策与备选决策的差异（投影 + 下游证据）。
description.en: Compares original vs alternative decision (projection + downstream evidence).

description.zh: 按编年志重演任意时间段的因果链，按 seed 生成确定性回放 run id，只读不修改世界状态。
description.en: Replays causal chains of any period from the chronicle, with a seed-derived deterministic run id; read-only.

description.zh: 按 seed 回放指定区间因果链，返回确定性 run id 与有序条目。
description.en: Replays the causal chain for a range, keyed by seed with a deterministic run id.

description.zh: 只读查询指定区间的因果链窗口。
description.en: Reads a causal-chain window for a range (read-only).

description.zh: 把编年志与审计结果导出为报告或 Markdown。
description.en: Exports chronicles and audits as reports or Markdown.

description.zh: 调用 observer.export.report。
description.en: Calls observer.export.report.

description.zh: 调用 observer.export.markdown。
description.en: Calls observer.export.markdown.

description.zh: 把智能体的决策、行为与事件逐条写入不可变日志。
description.en: Appends agent decisions, actions and events to an immutable log.

description.zh: 记录每一个智能体行为及其结果，写入图存储为不可变追加日志。
description.en: Records every agent action and its outcome into an immutable append log in the graph store.

description.zh: 记录一条智能体行为日志（tick、主体、行为与结果），返回已写入的日志节点快照。
description.en: Records one agent action (tick, subject, action and outcome) and returns the appended log-node snapshot.

description.zh: 记录每一次智能体决策：谁在哪个 tick、从哪些候选中选择了什么及理由，写入图存储为不可变追加日志。
description.en: Records every agent decision — who chose what from which options at which tick and why — into an immutable append log in the graph store.

description.zh: 记录一条智能体决策日志（tick、主体、候选、选择与理由），返回已写入的日志节点快照。
description.en: Records one agent decision (tick, subject, options, choice and reason) and returns the appended log-node snapshot.

description.zh: 记录世界事件并接入事件总线，写入图存储为不可变追加日志。
description.en: Records world events and connects to the event bus, appending to an immutable log in the graph store.

description.zh: 记录一条世界事件日志（tick、主题与载荷），返回已写入的日志节点快照。
description.en: Records one world event (tick, topic and payload) and returns the appended log-node snapshot.

description.zh: 提供任意时间区间的行为与决策时间线查询。
description.en: Queries behavior and decision timelines over arbitrary ranges.

description.zh: 调用 observer.timeline.get。
description.en: Calls observer.timeline.get.

description.zh: 调用 observer.timeline.range。
description.en: Calls observer.timeline.range.

description.zh: 驱动小镇内循环：世界时钟、主循环编排、感知分发、行动执行与世界状态管理。
description.en: Drives the town loop: world clock, cycle orchestration, perception routing, action dispatch and world-state management.

description.zh: 维护沙盘逻辑时间，按 tick 推进并调度周期任务。
description.en: Maintains logical time and schedules periodic tasks by ticks.

description.zh: 推进 1 个 tick 并触发到期的周期任务，返回新时间快照与触发任务。
description.en: Advances one tick and fires due periodic tasks, returning the new time snapshot and fired tasks.

description.zh: 读取当前逻辑时间快照（tick 与 startedAt）。
description.en: Reads the current logical time snapshot (tick and startedAt).

description.zh: 注册周期任务：每隔 interval 个 tick 触发一次，返回 id 与取消函数。
description.en: Registers a periodic task firing every interval ticks, returning its id and a cancel function.

description.zh: 编排感知-决策-行动主循环，协调智能体与世界状态的更新顺序。
description.en: Orchestrates the perceive-decide-act loop and coordinates agent and world updates.

description.zh: 控制主循环的启动、暂停、恢复与步进节奏。
description.en: Starts, pauses, resumes and steps the main loop.

description.zh: 同步推进 N 个 tick，每个 tick 先推进时钟再执行 step。
description.en: Synchronously advances N ticks; each tick advances the clock then runs the step.

description.zh: 暂停主循环（当前步进提前结束）。
description.en: Pauses the main loop (the current run ends early).

description.zh: 恢复主循环，使后续 run 继续推进。
description.en: Resumes the main loop so subsequent runs keep advancing.

description.zh: 把智能体决策结果解析为世界操作并提交执行。
description.en: Resolves agent decisions into world operations and commits them.

description.zh: 把解析后的操作提交到 world-state（记录 last_action 并可携带 effect）。
description.en: Commits resolved operations to world-state (recording last_action with optional effect).

description.zh: 归一化并校验智能体决策，产出可提交的世界操作。
description.en: Normalizes and validates agent decisions into committable world operations.

description.zh: 把 clock → survival 事件 → 感知 → agent 决策 → ai.thought → dispatch → world-state 串成最小闭环主循环，并在每个决策/行为/事件节点写入观察者日志；phase2 开启时再把社交家族（生育）、经济市场（交易）、制作建造、城镇空间（居住分配）、健康疾病接入每 tick 流程；phase3 开启时再把政治派系、文化规范与仪式、心理创伤与崩溃、技术研究与失传、文明遗产与重启接入每 tick 流程。
description.en: Wires clock → survival events → perception → agent decision → ai.thought → dispatch → world-state into a minimal closed main loop, recording observer logs at every decision/action/event node; with phase2 enabled it also drives procreation, market trading, crafting, residence allocation and health checks each tick; with phase3 enabled it also drives politics, culture (norms/ritual/meme), psyche (trauma/coping/breakdown), tech (research/loss) and civilization (legacy/collapse/restart) each tick.

description.zh: 登记一个智能体并初始化其特质、预想池与初始需求。
description.en: Registers an agent and initializes its traits, anticipation pool and initial needs.

description.zh: 推进一个 tick 的完整闭环（生存/感知/决策/思考/行动/世界状态）。
description.en: Advances one full closed-loop tick (survival/perception/decision/thought/action/world-state).

description.zh: 复位并运行 N 个 tick，返回整段运行的汇总报告。
description.en: Resets and runs N ticks, returning an aggregate report of the run.

description.zh: 返回当前世界状态、资源与编年计数的观测快照。
description.en: Returns an observation snapshot of world state, resources and chronicle counts.

description.zh: 复位全部共享状态（graph/rng/identity/clock/world-state/registry/needs/recorder）。
description.en: Resets all shared state (graph/rng/identity/clock/world-state/registry/needs/recorder).

description.zh: 返回世界采集池当前剩余量（每 tick 再生，供测试/观测）。
description.en: Returns the current remaining amount of the per-tick regenerating world forage pool (for tests/observation).

description.zh: 采集世界事件并分发给相关智能体，形成可感知上下文。
description.en: Collects world events and routes them to relevant agents as percepts.

description.zh: 归一化并暂存一批世界事件，形成 percept。
description.en: Normalizes and stages a batch of world events into percepts.

description.zh: 把 percept 按 targets 或全体 agent 分组，返回每个智能体的感知收件箱。
description.en: Routes percepts to targeted or all agents, returning each agent's perception inbox.

description.zh: 阶段二世界推进：产业/经济/制作队列推进、居民自选行动的实际执行（performAgentAction，含 P1 新增的 socialize/court/accept 与由居民双向决策产生的婚配）、社会与家庭汇总、疾病分诊等。
description.en: Phase-2 world stepping: industry/economy/craft queue advancement, execution of agent-chosen actions (including socialize/court/accept and decision-driven pairing), social and family aggregation, triage.

description.zh: 推进一步阶段二世界状态。
description.en: Advances phase-2 world state by one tick.

description.zh: 执行居民自己选择的动态行动（craft/build/write/work/trade/socialize/court），不可行时不改世界。
description.en: Executes an agent-chosen dynamic action; leaves world untouched when infeasible.

description.zh: 返回候选刷新所需的状态（hasPeer/employed/businessActive），按 tick 缓存。
description.en: Returns candidate-refresh state, cached per tick.

description.zh: 返回制作所需材料物品 id。
description.en: Returns the crafting material item id.

description.zh: 复位阶段二状态。
description.en: Resets phase-2 state.

description.zh: 登记智能体、建筑、企业等实体，提供查找与注销能力。
description.en: Registers agents, buildings and businesses with lookup and unregister support.

description.zh: 幂等登记一个实体（id/type/data），返回实体快照。
description.en: Idempotently registers an entity (id/type/data) and returns its snapshot.

description.zh: 按 id、type 或无条件查找实体。
description.en: Looks up entities by id, type, or unconditionally.

description.zh: 注销指定 id 的实体，返回被注销实体或 null。
description.en: Unregisters the entity with the given id, returning it or null.

description.zh: 保存与恢复世界快照，支持状态比对与内循环回滚。
description.en: Stores and restores world snapshots with diff and rollback support.

description.zh: 返回当前世界状态的深拷贝快照。
description.en: Returns a deep-copied snapshot of the current world state.

description.zh: 计算两份快照之间的叶子粒度结构化差异（added/changed/removed）。
description.en: Computes leaf-level structural diff (added/changed/removed) between two snapshots.

description.zh: 用一份快照整体替换当前状态，实现回滚/恢复。
description.en: Replaces the current state with a snapshot for rollback/restore.

description.zh: 智能体的社交网络、社交平台与关系系统，由生育形成家族，并涌现出治理、文化与声誉。
description.en: Agent social network, platform and relationships, with families from procreation, and emergent governance, culture and reputation.

description.zh: 社会规范、仪式与模因共同构成文明的软性秩序与身份认同。
description.en: Norms, rituals and memes form the civilization's soft order and identity.

description.zh: 观念在居民间传播、变异与消亡，写事件日志。
description.en: Ideas spread, mutate and die among residents, with event logging.

description.zh: 把一个模因从一名居民传给另一名居民。
description.en: Spreads a meme from one resident to another.

description.zh: 用 rng 变异一个模因出新代。
description.en: Mutates a meme into a new generation via rng.

description.zh: 标记一个模因消亡。
description.en: Marks a meme extinct.

description.zh: 定义被接受/禁止的行为规范，随违规与舆论漂移；违规施加社会压力约束行为。
description.en: Defines accepted/forbidden norms that drift with violations; violations apply social pressure that constrains behavior.

description.zh: 定义或更新一条社会规范（接受/禁止 + 强度）。
description.en: Defines or updates a norm (accepted/forbidden + strength).

description.zh: 查询规范（单条或全量）。
description.en: Queries norms (single or all).

description.zh: 记录违规并施加社会压力，写事件日志。
description.en: Records a violation, applies social pressure and writes the event log.

description.zh: 葬礼/丰收/命名/重启纪念等仪式的发起与举行，按周期触发并产生群体效果。
description.en: Holds funerals/harvests/naming/restart memorials, triggering periodically with group effects.

description.zh: 举行一场仪式（订馆 + 群体效果 + 写事件日志）。
description.en: Holds a ritual (venue booking + group effect + event log).

description.zh: 注册一个按周期触发的仪式日程。
description.en: Registers a periodically-triggered ritual schedule.

description.zh: 由持续生育形成的家族：登记、谱系、家族特质（三代稳定遗传后固化，最多 5 个）与家族编年史。
description.en: Families formed through procreation: registry, lineage, family traits (fixed after 3 stable generations, max 5) and family chronicles.

description.zh: 记录家族成员的重要事件并编译成家族史。
description.en: Records major family events and compiles family history.

description.zh: 调用 social.family.chronicle.append。
description.en: Calls social.family.chronicle.append.

description.zh: 调用 social.family.chronicle.compile。
description.en: Calls social.family.chronicle.compile.

description.zh: 把家族特质（最多 5 个）应用到每个新诞生在该家族系下的智能体。
description.en: Applies family traits (max 5) to every agent born into the family line.

description.zh: 把家族特质合并进族内新生儿的 50 标签串。
description.en: Merges family traits into the 50-tag set of newborn family members.

description.zh: 调用 social.family.inherit.applier.apply。
description.en: Calls social.family.inherit.applier.apply.

description.zh: 调用 social.family.inherit.applier.merge。
description.en: Calls social.family.inherit.applier.merge.

description.zh: 查询与审计家族特质继承记录。
description.en: Queries and audits family trait inheritance records.

description.zh: 调用 social.family.inherit.verifier.query。
description.en: Calls social.family.inherit.verifier.query.

description.zh: 调用 social.family.inherit.verifier.audit。
description.en: Calls social.family.inherit.verifier.audit.

description.zh: 追踪家族代际与成员血缘关系。
description.en: Traces family generations and blood relations.

description.zh: 调用 social.family.lineage.trace。
description.en: Calls social.family.lineage.trace.

description.zh: 调用 social.family.lineage.generation。
description.en: Calls social.family.lineage.generation.

description.zh: 创建、查找与解散家族。
description.en: Creates, looks up and dissolves families.

description.zh: 调用 social.family.registry.create。
description.en: Calls social.family.registry.create.

description.zh: 调用 social.family.registry.lookup。
description.en: Calls social.family.registry.lookup.

description.zh: 调用 social.family.registry.dissolve。
description.en: Calls social.family.registry.dissolve.

description.zh: 当某 tag 在家族内连续遗传三代未遗失，即固化为家族特质；家族最多 5 个特质。
description.en: Fixes a tag as a family trait when it survives three generations without loss; max 5 family traits.

description.zh: 检测某 tag 是否在家族内连续遗传三代未遗失。
description.en: Detects whether a tag survived three generations without loss.

description.zh: 调用 social.family.trait.detector.detect。
description.en: Calls social.family.trait.detector.detect.

description.zh: 调用 social.family.trait.detector.three_generations。
description.en: Calls social.family.trait.detector.three_generations.

description.zh: 把检测通过的特质固化为家族特质，并强制不超过 5 个。
description.en: Fixes detected traits as family traits and enforces the max of 5.

description.zh: 调用 social.family.trait.enforcer.set。
description.en: Calls social.family.trait.enforcer.set.

description.zh: 调用 social.family.trait.enforcer.limit。
description.en: Calls social.family.trait.enforcer.limit.

description.zh: 维护智能体之间的关系边与社区结构。
description.en: Maintains relationship edges and community structure among agents.

description.zh: 识别社交圈与社区归属，影响信息传播。
description.en: Detects circles and communities that shape information flow.

description.zh: 调用 social.graph.community.detect。
description.en: Calls social.graph.community.detect.

description.zh: 调用 social.graph.community.belong。
description.en: Calls social.graph.community.belong.

description.zh: 创建与移除朋友、恋人、家人等关系边。
description.en: Creates and removes friend, lover and family edges.

description.zh: 调用 social.graph.edges.create。
description.en: Calls social.graph.edges.create.

description.zh: 调用 social.graph.edges.remove。
description.en: Calls social.graph.edges.remove.

description.zh: 镇内社交平台：发帖、回复、信息流与内容治理。
description.en: Town social platform: posts, replies, feeds and moderation.

description.zh: 按关系与兴趣为智能体生成和排序信息流。
description.en: Generates and ranks feeds by relationships and interests.

description.zh: 调用 social.platform.feeds.generate。
description.en: Calls social.platform.feeds.generate.

description.zh: 调用 social.platform.feeds.rank。
description.en: Calls social.platform.feeds.rank.

description.zh: 发布、回复与回应帖子，承载公共表达。
description.en: Publishes posts, replies and reactions for public expression.

description.zh: 调用 social.platform.posts.publish。
description.en: Calls social.platform.posts.publish.

description.zh: 调用 social.platform.posts.reply。
description.en: Calls social.platform.posts.reply.

description.zh: 调用 social.platform.posts.react。
description.en: Calls social.platform.posts.react.

description.zh: 居民自组织治理：派系、规则、领导与冲突，权力和秩序从智能体的互动中涌现。
description.en: Self-organized governance: factions, laws, leaders and conflict emerge from agent interactions.

description.zh: 派系或个体间从口角到械斗的冲突，消耗资源并可能造成伤亡。
description.en: Conflicts from arguments to faction fights, costing resources and lives.

description.zh: 开启冲突。
description.en: Starts a conflict.

description.zh: 解决冲突（升级/调停/和解）。
description.en: Resolves a conflict (escalate/mediate/settle).

description.zh: 按生存策略、资源争夺或家族利益形成、加入与退出派系。
description.en: Forms, joins and leaves factions around survival strategy, resources or family interests.

description.zh: 创建派系（指定创始成员）。
description.en: Forms a faction (with a founding member).

description.zh: 加入派系。
description.en: Joins a faction.

description.zh: 退出派系（无人时解散）。
description.en: Leaves a faction (dissolves when empty).

description.zh: 由居民提出、投票与执行避难所规则。
description.en: Proposes, votes and enforces shelter rules.

description.zh: 提议一条规则。
description.en: Proposes a law.

description.zh: 表决规则（简单多数通过）。
description.en: Votes on a law (simple majority passes).

description.zh: 执行已生效规则。
description.en: Enforces an enacted law.

description.zh: 推举、罢免领导者，并由其发布政令。
description.en: Elects and ousts leaders who issue decrees.

description.zh: 选举领导（支持度更高者更替）。
description.en: Elects a leader (higher support replaces).

description.zh: 罢免领导。
description.en: Ousts the leader.

description.zh: 领导发布政令。
description.en: Leader issues a decree.

description.zh: 评估配对并生成新智能体，把孩子接入家庭与社会。
description.en: Evaluates couples and creates children who join family and society.

description.zh: 评估恋爱双方的契合度与繁衍条件。
description.en: Evaluates romantic compatibility and readiness for children.

description.zh: 调用 social.procreation.match.evaluate。
description.en: Calls social.procreation.match.evaluate.

description.zh: 调用 social.procreation.match.pair。
description.en: Calls social.procreation.match.pair.

description.zh: 请求创建子代并调用遗传与提示词组装流程。
description.en: Requests offspring creation and invokes heredity and prompt assembly.

description.zh: 调用 social.procreation.offspring.request。
description.en: Calls social.procreation.offspring.request.

description.zh: 调用 social.procreation.offspring.compose。
description.en: Calls social.procreation.offspring.compose.

description.zh: 管理恋爱、家庭与友谊关系的建立、维持与解除。
description.en: Manages romantic, family and friendship bonds over time.

description.zh: 记录父母子女与亲属关系，支持家族追踪。
description.en: Records parent-child and kinship relations for family tracing.

description.zh: 调用 social.relationship.family.trace。
description.en: Calls social.relationship.family.trace.

description.zh: 调用 social.relationship.family.label。
description.en: Calls social.relationship.family.label.

description.zh: 更新友谊强度与互动历史。
description.en: Updates friendship strength and interaction history.

description.zh: 调用 social.relationship.friendship.update。
description.en: Calls social.relationship.friendship.update.

description.zh: 调用 social.relationship.friendship.strength。
description.en: Calls social.relationship.friendship.strength.

description.zh: 处理表白、接受、拒绝与分手，支持配对与亲密升级。
description.en: Handles proposals, acceptance, rejection and breakups.

description.zh: 调用 social.relationship.romance.propose。
description.en: Calls social.relationship.romance.propose.

description.zh: 调用 social.relationship.romance.accept。
description.en: Calls social.relationship.romance.accept.

description.zh: 调用 social.relationship.romance.breakup。
description.en: Calls social.relationship.romance.breakup.

description.zh: 根据社交与交易行为更新声誉并供查询。
description.en: Updates and queries reputation from social and economic behavior.

description.zh: 调用 social.reputation.update。
description.en: Calls social.reputation.update.

description.zh: 调用 social.reputation.query。
description.en: Calls social.reputation.query.

description.zh: 核战争后 LinYi 号避难所居民的生存层：资源、需求、疾病、环境与突发事件，目标只有一个——继续活下去，并记录存活时长。
description.en: Survival layer for post-nuclear LinYi Shelter residents: resources, needs, disease, environment and events, with one goal — keep living and record survival time.

description.zh: 检测群体性生存危机并发出警报，为文明崩溃判定提供输入。
description.en: Detects collective survival crises and raises alerts for collapse judgement.

description.zh: 调用 survival.crisis.detect。
description.en: Calls survival.crisis.detect.

description.zh: 调用 survival.crisis.alert。
description.en: Calls survival.crisis.alert.

description.zh: 避难所外的世界不做开放世界：辐射与天气作为探索计算的风险因子，探索被简化为一次结算，产出日志、资源变化与 Agent 状态变化。
description.en: The outside world is not an open world: radiation and weather serve as risk factors, and expeditions are simplified into one resolution producing a log plus resource and agent-state changes.

description.zh: 把外出探索简化为一次计算：综合辐射、天气、物资、装备、Agent 特质、生存状态与随机数，得出探索结果；结果仅体现为一段日志、资源变化和 Agent 状态变化，不创建开放世界。
description.en: Resolves expeditions as one computation combining radiation, weather, supplies, gear, agent traits, survival state and randomness; the result is only a log entry plus resource and agent-state changes — no open world.

description.zh: 评估本次探索的条件、风险与预期收益。
description.en: Assesses conditions, risks and expected gains for an expedition.

description.zh: 综合各方因素与随机数，计算探索结果。
description.en: Computes the expedition outcome from factors and randomness.

description.zh: 把探索结果落为日志、资源变化和 Agent 状态变化。
description.en: Settles the outcome as a log entry plus resource and agent-state changes.

description.zh: 作为探索结算的风险因子，查询辐射强度并计算其扩散。
description.en: Queries radiation intensity and spreads it as a risk factor for expedition resolution.

description.zh: 调用 survival.environment.radiation.query。
description.en: Calls survival.environment.radiation.query.

description.zh: 调用 survival.environment.radiation.spread。
description.en: Calls survival.environment.radiation.spread.

description.zh: 作为探索结算与突发事件的影响因子，预测并施加灾变天气。
description.en: Forecasts and strikes with disasters as a factor for expedition resolution and events.

description.zh: 调用 survival.environment.weather.forecast。
description.en: Calls survival.environment.weather.forecast.

description.zh: 调用 survival.environment.weather.strike。
description.en: Calls survival.environment.weather.strike.

description.zh: 生成并施加核后世界的突发事件，如辐射尘、设备故障、资源危机与外来者。
description.en: Generates and applies post-nuclear events: fallout, breakdowns, resource crises and outsiders.

description.zh: 按概率掷出并选择突发事件。
description.en: Rolls and selects random events by probability.

description.zh: 用随机数掷出是否发生突发事件。
description.en: Rolls whether a random event occurs.

description.zh: 掷出是否发生突发事件（probability 夹在 [0,1]）。
description.en: Rolls whether a random event occurs (probability clamped to [0,1]).

description.zh: 固定随机源，保证突发事件序列可回放。
description.en: Seeds the RNG so event sequences are reproducible.

description.zh: 按权重选择具体突发事件。
description.en: Selects a concrete event by weight.

description.zh: 按权重抽取一个具体突发事件。
description.en: Selects a concrete event by weight.

description.zh: 归一化事件并按类型倍率计算权重。
description.en: Normalizes events and computes weights with per-type multipliers.

description.zh: 把突发事件施加到避难所、资源与居民，并解决事件链。
description.en: Applies events to shelter, resources and residents, and resolves event chains.

description.zh: 把单个突发事件施加到避难所、资源并记录事件日志。
description.en: Applies a single event to shelter/resources and records it to the event log.

description.zh: 解决突发事件及其事件链，返回完整影响结果。
description.en: Resolves events and their chains, returning the full impact results.

description.zh: 把“继续活下去”作为最高目标，输出生存策略并统计已存活时长。
description.en: Makes survival the top goal, outputs survival strategy and tracks elapsed time.

description.zh: 调用 survival.goal.survive。
description.en: Calls survival.goal.survive.

description.zh: 调用 survival.goal.elapsed。
description.en: Calls survival.goal.elapsed.

description.zh: 疾病、治疗与疫情，让医疗资源成为会逼人做选择的生存压力。
description.en: Disease, treatment and epidemics turn medical resources into hard choices.

description.zh: 感染、症状发展与康复，受特质免疫与医疗物资影响。
description.en: Infection, symptom progression and recovery shaped by trait immunity and medical supplies.

description.zh: 施加感染，受特质免疫抵抗或削弱。
description.en: Applies an infection, resisted or weakened by trait immunity.

description.zh: 推进症状：严重度上升、健康下降。
description.en: Progresses symptoms: severity rises and health declines.

description.zh: 康复：严重度下降、健康回升，受免疫与医疗物资加成。
description.en: Recovers: severity falls and health rises, boosted by immunity and medical supplies.

description.zh: 检测疫情并触发隔离、恐慌与互助行为。
description.en: Detects epidemics and triggers quarantine, panic and mutual aid.

description.zh: 统计感染率并按阈值判定疫情，判定为疫情时写观察日志。
description.en: Counts the infection rate, flags an epidemic by threshold, and logs it when detected.

description.zh: 隔离某居民并记录观察日志。
description.en: Quarantines a resident and records an observer log.

description.zh: 由医生角色分诊并消耗医疗物资实施治疗。
description.en: Triages and treats patients using medical supplies.

description.zh: 消耗医疗物资实施一次治疗。
description.en: Consumes medical supplies and applies one treatment.

description.zh: 按病情严重度降序分诊患者。
description.en: Triages patients by descending severity.

description.zh: 计量饥饿、口渴、健康与理智，并把缺口转化为生存压力。
description.en: Meters hunger, thirst, health and sanity, converting deficits into survival pressure.

description.zh: 更新并查询每个居民的生存需求水平。
description.en: Updates and queries survival need levels for each resident.

description.zh: 更新某居民某类需求水平（level 绝对或 delta 相对，夹在 [0,1]）。
description.en: Updates a resident's need level (absolute level or relative delta, clamped to [0,1]).

description.zh: 查询居民需求水平（含 food/water 稀缺度）。
description.en: Queries resident need levels together with food/water scarcity.

description.zh: 根据需求缺口与资源稀缺度给智能体生存压力评分与排序。
description.en: Scores and ranks survival pressure from need deficits and scarcity.

description.zh: 按压力评分排序并给出高危名单。
description.en: Ranks pressure scores and lists high-risk residents.

description.zh: 按压力评分降序稳定排序（同分按 agentId 升序）。
description.en: Ranks pressure scores in descending stable order (ties by agentId ascending).

description.zh: 取压力最高前 N 名并按 threshold 标注高危。
description.en: Returns the top N highest-pressure residents flagged high-risk by threshold.

description.zh: 综合需求缺口与资源稀缺度给每个居民评分。
description.en: Scores each resident from need deficits and scarcity.

description.zh: 综合需求缺口与稀缺度给居民评分（score 与归一化 normalized）。
description.en: Scores a resident from need deficits and scarcity (score and normalized).

description.zh: 计算单类需求因子的压力贡献 level×(1+scarcity)×weight。
description.en: Computes one need factor as level×(1+scarcity)×weight.

description.zh: 水、食物、能源与医疗物资的生产、消耗与库存，构成生存硬约束。
description.en: Water, food, energy and medical supplies form hard survival constraints.

description.zh: 追踪能源的生产、消耗与库存。
description.en: Tracks energy production, consumption and stockpile.

description.zh: 调用 survival.resources.energy.produce。
description.en: Calls survival.resources.energy.produce.

description.zh: 调用 survival.resources.energy.consume。
description.en: Calls survival.resources.energy.consume.

description.zh: 调用 survival.resources.energy.query。
description.en: Calls survival.resources.energy.query.

description.zh: 追踪食物的生产、消耗与库存。
description.en: Tracks food production, consumption and stockpile.

description.zh: 增产：库存最多增至容量上限，返回实际增产后的库存快照。
description.en: Produces food, capping the stockpile at capacity and returning the resulting stock snapshot.

description.zh: 消耗：库存至少减到 0，返回实际消耗量与剩余库存。
description.en: Consumes food, clamping the stockpile at 0 and returning the actual consumed amount and remaining stock.

description.zh: 查询食物库存快照（含稀缺度 scarcity）。
description.en: Queries the food stockpile snapshot including scarcity.

description.zh: 追踪药品与医疗物资的生产、消耗与库存。
description.en: Tracks medicine and medical supply production, consumption and stockpile.

description.zh: 调用 survival.resources.medical.produce。
description.en: Calls survival.resources.medical.produce.

description.zh: 调用 survival.resources.medical.consume。
description.en: Calls survival.resources.medical.consume.

description.zh: 调用 survival.resources.medical.query。
description.en: Calls survival.resources.medical.query.

description.zh: 追踪水源的生产、消耗与库存。
description.en: Tracks water production, consumption and stockpile.

description.zh: 增产：库存最多增至容量上限，返回实际增产后的库存快照。
description.en: Produces water, capping the stockpile at capacity and returning the resulting stock snapshot.

description.zh: 消耗：库存至少减到 0，返回实际消耗量与剩余库存。
description.en: Consumes water, clamping the stockpile at 0 and returning the actual consumed amount and remaining stock.

description.zh: 查询水源库存快照（含稀缺度 scarcity）。
description.en: Queries the water stockpile snapshot including scarcity.

description.zh: 维护 LinYi 号避难所的结构完整度、人口容量与损伤状态。
description.en: Maintains LinYi Shelter integrity, capacity and damage state.

description.zh: 调用 survival.shelter.status。
description.en: Calls survival.shelter.status.

description.zh: 调用 survival.shelter.capacity。
description.en: Calls survival.shelter.capacity.

description.zh: 调用 survival.shelter.damage。
description.en: Calls survival.shelter.damage.

description.zh: 调用 survival.shelter.repair（以劳动力修复完整度、使容量回升）。
description.en: Calls survival.shelter.repair (repairs integrity and raises capacity).

description.zh: LinYi 号避难所的结构化空间与建筑系统：地图、分区、建筑、住宅、公共设施与土地，不依赖美术资产。
description.en: Structured spaces and buildings of the LinYi Shelter: map, zoning, structures, housing, facilities and land, without art assets.

description.zh: 创建结构化建筑与可分配空间。
description.en: Creates structured buildings and allocatable spaces.

description.zh: 在建筑内分配与释放房间、工位与铺面。
description.en: Allocates and releases rooms, desks and shop spaces.

description.zh: 在建筑内分配一个房间/工位/床给占用者（容量校验）。
description.en: Allocates a room/desk/bed to an occupant (capacity-checked).

description.zh: 释放一个空间并清空占用者。
description.en: Releases a space and clears its occupant.

description.zh: 建造与拆除建筑，记录体量与功能。
description.en: Constructs and demolishes buildings with volume and function.

description.zh: 建造一栋建筑，记录体量（容量）与功能。
description.en: Constructs a building, recording volume (capacity) and function.

description.zh: 拆除一栋建筑。
description.en: Demolishes a building.

description.zh: 一键生成初始避难所（核心区/宿舍/食堂/水站等默认建筑与容量）。
description.en: Generates the initial shelter (core/dorms/canteen/water station with default capacity).

description.zh: 登记与使用公共设施和可预约场所。
description.en: Registers public facilities and bookable venues.

description.zh: 登记公园、医院、学校等公共设施并记录使用。
description.en: Registers and uses parks, hospitals and schools.

description.zh: 调用 town.facility.public.register。
description.en: Calls town.facility.public.register.

description.zh: 调用 town.facility.public.use。
description.en: Calls town.facility.public.use.

description.zh: 预订与取消活动场馆。
description.en: Books and cancels event venues.

description.zh: 预订一个场馆（记录预订者、tick 区间与用途）。
description.en: Books a venue (records booker, tick window and purpose).

description.zh: 取消一个场馆预约。
description.en: Cancels a venue booking.

description.zh: 取得与转让土地，作为建筑与企业空间的基础。
description.en: Acquires and transfers land as the basis for buildings and business sites.

description.zh: 调用 town.land.acquire。
description.en: Calls town.land.acquire.

description.zh: 调用 town.land.transfer。
description.en: Calls town.land.transfer.

description.zh: 维护小镇空间拓扑与功能区划。
description.en: Maintains spatial topology and functional zoning.

description.zh: 查询与规划道路、地块和邻接关系。
description.en: Queries and plans roads, plots and adjacency.

description.zh: 规划（登记）一个地块或道路，记录坐标与邻接关系。
description.en: Plans (registers) a plot or road with coordinates and adjacency.

description.zh: 查询拓扑：全部 / 按 id / 按 kind（plot/road）过滤。
description.en: Queries topology: all / by id / filtered by kind (plot/road).

description.zh: 划分商业、居住、公共等区域并可重划。
description.en: Assigns and rezones commercial, residential and public districts.

description.zh: 划定一个商业/居住/公共/工业分区并声明容量。
description.en: Assigns a commercial/residential/public/industrial district with capacity.

description.zh: 重划已有分区（改类型或容量，保留地块）。
description.en: Rezones an existing district (changes kind or capacity, keeps plots).

description.zh: 处理入住、搬出与租金，连接家庭与住房。
description.en: Handles move-in, move-out and rent linking families to housing.

description.zh: 居民入住某住宅。
description.en: Moves a resident into a residence.

description.zh: 居民搬出某住宅（未指定住所则从全部住宅移除）。
description.en: Moves a resident out (removes from all residences if unspecified).

description.zh: 记录某居民在住宅的租金（累加）。
description.en: Records a resident's rent at a residence (accumulated).

label.zh: 读取特质选择应对方式
读取生存压力累积创伤

reading.zh: 从十二个领域进入：运行时与生存系统驱动避难所日常，智能体带着心理、背包与制作能力参与社会、治理、经济与空间互动；观察者记录并实验，文明通过技术与遗物积累并重启。箭头表示依赖方向。
reading.en: Enter through twelve domains: runtime and survival drive shelter life; agents with psyche, backpacks and crafting join social, political, economic and spatial life; the observer records and experiments; civilization accumulates and restarts through tech and relics. Arrows show dependency direction.

reading.zh: 从人格、特质与心理出发，经日程、预想池与决策，到背包、制作、记忆、生命周期与社会角色。
reading.en: From persona, traits and psyche through schedule, anticipation and decision to backpack, crafting, memory, lifecycle and roles.

reading.zh: 查看 行动预想池 的内部组成，箭头表示模块间依赖。
reading.en: Inspect the internals of Anticipation Pool; arrows show dependencies.

reading.zh: 查看 预想池实现 的实现组成，箭头表示模块间依赖。
reading.en: Inspect the implementation of Anticipation Pool Implementation; arrows show dependencies.

reading.zh: 查看 制作系统 的内部组成，箭头表示模块间依赖。
reading.en: Inspect the internals of Crafting; arrows show dependencies.

reading.zh: 查看 制作物品实现 的实现组成，箭头表示模块间依赖。
reading.en: Inspect the implementation of Workbench Implementation; arrows show dependencies.

reading.zh: 查看 物品与背包 的内部组成，箭头表示模块间依赖。
reading.en: Inspect the internals of Inventory & Backpack; arrows show dependencies.
